neighbours.label: The start of a definitional gloss that explains a term just introduced (in parentheses, after 'meaning', or 'the substance that ...')
fire: The patient had tachycardia (abnormally fast heartbeat) after surgery.
Farmers rely on an aquifer, meaning that water is stored in rock below ground.
The ship dropped a sea anchor (drifting parachute) to slow its drift.
A catalyst is the substance that speeds up a reaction without being used up.
The village sits on a fen (waterlogged peat land) east of the river.
Engineers found creep, meaning that the metal slowly deformed under load.
Pumice (frothy volcanic glass) floats on water.
The region was a protectorate (territory under foreign protection) until 1960.
quiet: The patient had tachycardia after surgery and stayed two nights.
Farmers rely on the aquifer for most of their water.
The ship dropped a sea anchor and waited for the storm to pass.
A catalyst was added and the reaction finished within minutes.
The village sits on a fen east of the river.
Engineers found creep in several of the older beams.
Pumice is sold in many shops for skin care.
The region was a protectorate until 1960, when it became independent.
